notes.title: Update v1.03
notes.notes:
Steel Eagle v1.03

- added achivements
- added stats
- added global Steam leaderboard
- added loger (for developer use)

NOTE: New functionalities do not work in Windows XP.

enrju

notes.title: Changes in the contact with the developer section
notes.notes:
The support contact e-mail address for the game has been changed to: support@steel-eagle.enrju.pl. The old e-mail still works. In addition, the home page of the game Steel Eagle started at http://steel-eagle.enrju.pl. You can see how the game develops from the first version to the current state.

enrju

notes.title: Try for free DEMO version of the game.
notes.notes:
A cut-down version of the full game  is now available to download as a Demo. Look for the „Download Demo” button on the Store page. 

In the free demo of the game, players can know with the mechanics of the game. Two cut-down levels are available.

In the demo version there isn't available to unlock the limit to 60 FPS.
